mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in one month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5pp and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO increases > 1% MoM and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3 percentage points, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE increases > 0.3pp
failure_condition: If HOUST declines > 10% YoY and UNRATE increases > 0.3pp, and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a potential economic slowdown due to tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with slowing growth
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ growth < 1% and FEDFUNDS > 4%, and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.
